description: Defines a public enumeration `OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction` with nested structures, static utility functions for handling action messages, JSON serialization, and string sanitization related to a specific user interface action in a Canvas/OpenClaw context.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction
classes.description: A public enum encapsulating related data structures and methods for UI actions in the Canvas context.

classes.name: AgentMessageContext
classes.description: A nested structure representing the context of an agent message, including session and component details.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Holds session-related identifiers such as key and surfaceId.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Contains component-related identifiers such as id, host, and instanceId.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts an action name from a user-provided dictionary with keys 'name' or 'action'.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string value for safe inclusion in tags by trimming, replacing spaces, and filtering allowed characters.

methods.name: compactJSON
methods.description: Converts a Swift object to a compact JSON string if valid.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Formats a message string including action, session, component details, and optional context JSON.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript code snippet that dispatches a custom event with action status information.
